events.title: Section 232 minimum-import-price floor on polysilicon/solar takes effect
events.why_it_matters: Minimum-import-price floors on polysilicon (USD 21/kg), ingots/wafers (USD 100/kg), solar cells (USD 0.22/W) and solar modules (USD 0.38/W) take effect for US goods entered for consumption from 00:01 ET on this date, plus a flat tariff; US polysilicon/wafer/cell capacity behind the floor is the un-mapped side of a headline solar-tariff story dominated by module assemblers.
events.source_name: Wiley, Trump Administration Imposes Section 232 Tariffs and Minimum Import Prices on Polysilicon and its Derivatives

events.title: China's rare-earth export-control suspension expires
events.why_it_matters: MOFCOM Announcements No. 61 and 62 of 2025 (export controls on rare-earth mining, smelting/separation, metal production, magnet manufacturing and related technology and recycling) are suspended only from 2026-11-07 to this fixed date; whether Beijing renews, narrows or lets the suspension lapse resets the whole downstream magnet-supply-chain thesis inside the window, and MOFCOM has not stated its reasoning either way.
events.source_name: CIRS Group, China Temporarily Suspends Export Controls on Key Raw Materials
